title: The Temple, part four: the Your house page, read-only, from the reader's own session

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const rt=r('app/api/sites/[slug]/rsvps/route.ts'),pg=r('components/sites/site-page.tsx'),ht=r('lib/sites/house-theme.ts'),st=r('lib/sites/editor/state.ts'),ac=r('components/sites/site-account.tsx');if(!rt.includes('getMyProfileId')||!rt.includes(\".eq('profile_id', profileId)\"))bad.push('rsvps route is not gated on the reader own session');if(!ht.includes(\"SITE_ACCOUNT_SLUG = 'account'\"))bad.push('account slug');if(!st.includes(\"'account'\"))bad.push('account is not a reserved website slug');if(!pg.includes('accountPage')||!pg.includes('index: false, follow: false'))bad.push('account page not served noindex');if(/method:\\s*'(POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE)'/.test(ac))bad.push('the account island writes');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1296: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

detail: Follows LIVE-1286. A Temple website serves /account, 'Your house': a client island (components/sites/site-account.tsx) that asks Frequency, with the reader's own session, for their plan (the existing membership route, which now also answers their first name) and the upcoming gatherings they are going to (new app/api/sites/[slug]/rsvps, own rows only, narrowed to events this Space owns or hosts, same Origin and credentials gates as the membership route). The cached HTML carries no member data. READ ONLY: an RSVP is made and changed on Frequency through the labeled Open button, never from a cached site. 'account' is a reserved website slug, the page is noindex, and the Temple account pill now links to it. Still open: the week-strip arches' own data (day notes and recurring anchors); the standing-week section draws the owner's cards as the design's arches.
